name: Ren
source:
Job: School Physician
Ren (Shinobu's older twin by 3 seconds...yes twins. Obviously we had to include this overused and uncreative trope) has a cruel and kinky demeanor. Despite that, I'm sure the ladies will still go for him cause he's dashing as fuck! You all need serious help, and not the kind that Ren gives. He works at the University as the school physician. He'll fifty shades of feline your ass.
